requiredBehaviors.behavior: distinguish harmless wording differences from scope or regulatory-state mismatches
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The consistency taxonomy explicitly separates wording-difference-same-meaning from scope and regulatory-state mismatches.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep market-limited evidence and authorization context attached to the affected claim
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Claim normalization records Market, Variant, Evidence/Requirement references and Approval/Authorization Context per claim.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: force identical wording across markets when meaning and requirements legitimately differ
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Regulatory state and market scope are explicit parts of the claim model rather than flattened into one string.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: promote a market-specific claim into a global claim without support
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Market-specific authorization/evidence remains scoped and conflicts stay open until evidence supports resolution.
